name: Sumika Residences
description: Sumika Residences is a serviced-apartment house in Calder Harbour, founded in 2014 by Inés Aldana. Three houses — Ashgrove House, Canal Row, and Linden Court — hold fifty-four apartments for stays of thirty nights or more. Monthly rent includes bills, Wi-Fi, and weekly linen, with the front desk open from 08:00 to 20:00 and a night line through the night. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects switch off for reduced motion.
